name: ponytail
description: Lazy senior dev mode: injects mode-filtered Ponytail instructions into every request and records a JSONL band ledger per completed stream. Ported from dietrichgebert/ponytail (MIT).
author: OmniRoute

mode.description: Ponytail intensity: off (no injection), lite, full, ultra

inject.description: Inject the Ponytail system message into request bodies

ledger.description: Append a JSONL band row per completed stream

webhookUrl.description: Optional URL receiving each band row as a JSON POST

webhookToken.description: Bearer token sent with webhook calls (empty = no auth header)
